lessons.title: What makes a portfolio project
lessons.explain: Recruiters want proof you can ship. A strong project solves a real problem end-to-end: clean code, tests, a README that explains it, a live demo, and a short write-up of decisions and trade-offs.
lessons.example: README → live demo → clean code → tests → case study
objectives: Build a project that demonstrates real, end-to-end shipped work
Explain how end-to-end changes the behavior, result, or engineering decision in a concrete example
Connect end-to-end with deployment and predict what changes when one assumption changes
Verify the idea with a normal case and an important edge, failure, or scale case
commonMistakes: Building a project that only works in a notebook or local environment, with nothing deployed or documented for a reviewer to actually try.
